note: The commit every kernel here is proved against. scripts/bend-checkout.mjs fetches it from upstream by sha; spec/build-kernel.ts and spec/laws-check.ts refuse a checkout at any other commit. Upstream keeps one squashed commit that has been force-pushed before, so the sha can vanish there; a mirror that keeps it under a tag is named by BEND_MIRROR (a git URL) and BEND_MIRROR_TAG when you have one, and is tried first when set. Move the pin by re-cloning, re-running every PROOF, and pushing the new commit to your mirror under a new tag.
